title: Perfect derived pairing
statement:
In the Poincare duality conventions [def-pod-conventions] of this chapter, let
$\Lambda\in\{A,\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb\}$, and let $C,D$ be
perfect point complexes [def-pod-perfect-point-complex]
over $\Lambda$ in the point coefficient categories of
[def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Use the coefficient-stage derived tensor
and internal Hom of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and their
tensor–internal-Hom adjunction [sk-def-sf-operations] (i), read in these
point categories. At $\Lambda=\Qlb$ the point category is the common-stage
category [def-weil-point-fd-qlbar-category]; tensor products, the coefficient
unit and internal Hom are formed over common finite coefficient fields,
with the common-stage interpretation of the cited operations.
A morphism

$$
b:C\otimes _\Lambda^LD\longrightarrow \Lambda
$$

is *perfect* if its tensor–internal-Hom adjoint

$$
D\longrightarrow R\operatorname {Hom}_\Lambda(C,\Lambda)=C^\vee
$$

is an isomorphism. Here the adjoint means the image of $b$ under the
natural adjunction bijection
$$
\operatorname{Hom}(C\otimes^L_\Lambda D,\Lambda)
\cong\operatorname{Hom}\bigl(D,R\operatorname{Hom}_\Lambda(C,\Lambda)\bigr),
$$
and $C^\vee$ is the point derived dual of [def-pod-perfect-point-complex].
